source.modified: Column subset, values trimmed, corrections in shared/trends-corrections.json, aggregated into trend records.
source.caveat: NFL data belongs to its respective owners; the CC BY license does not extend to upstream rights such as the odds columns, whose book is not documented.

lineSource: nflverse schedule file: last recorded line (book not documented)

scoreMax.statistic: best score in each shuffled run (thresholds.max.emp_p)

tier2Gate.note: The Tier 2 gate passes about as many rows on shuffled outcomes as on real ones; Tier 2 as a group is not distinguishable from chance.

bestOosRoi.note: Never rank by ROI: the best out-of-sample ROI on shuffled outcomes is as high as on real data.

copy.reference: Past results against nflverse lines. Reference only: not a betting recommendation, and trends never change GTL scoring.
copy.evidence: In out-of-sample testing (2018-2025) only one trend beat chance: strong wind at kickoff (10+ mph) went Under, on played games. It needs observed wind, so it never applies to an upcoming game.
copy.selection: Results 2018-2025 (period used to select this card)
copy.prospective: Since registered Oct 12, 2026 (the only prospective record)
copy.calibration: Not proven: on shuffled outcomes the same gate passes about as many trends (13.3 on average) as on real data (12).
copy.tier3: No proven edge. Full-history records are shown both ways; the walk-forward record picks each season's side from earlier seasons only.
copy.windConditional: Applies only if kickoff wind is 10+ mph; no forecast source
copy.wind15Conditional: Applies only if kickoff wind is 15+ mph; no forecast source
copy.weatherConditional: Applies only to observed kickoff weather; no forecast source
copy.roofConditional: Applies only if the retractable roof is closed
copy.qbProvisional: Starting QBs for upcoming games are nflverse's expected starters (provisional).
copy.scoring: Scores and tiers use completed seasons (through the last full season); this season appears as This season and Since registered.
copy.stacked: Same side as another card; they are not independent confirmations.
copy.lineSource: Line source: nflverse schedule file: last recorded line (book not documented)

team_ats.label: ATS team with the trait vs its opponent

schemaNotes.rows: rows[id]: compact Tier 3, entity and referee records. split = [side A, side B, pushes] over every game since 2002 (in-sample, shown both ways). wf = walk-forward record [W, L, P] from wfFrom on, each season's side chosen from earlier seasons only (streak and last10 on that record; units at -110 = W * 0.9091 - L). oos = the walk-forward record 2018 through the last full season (the score's evidence). side = this season's side (A or B, see markets) fixed from earlier seasons; season and since = this season and since registration on that side. registered = a registered side's full record. Sides: markets[market].sides.
schemaNotes.conditional: games[].conditional[].note is a key of copy.
schemaNotes.items: Context, gated and band items are row ids; "id@TEAM" binds a team trait to that team. gatedCards hold card references ({ card, team }) that unlock after the named ballot (spread, total or both).
schemaNotes.omitted: A row without years spans 2002 through this season; a row without seasons has games in every season of its years; a row with wf but no wfFrom starts its walk-forward record in 2003. Referee rows carry no title: label them from the referees map (career, primetime, divisional, total band). A row without wf has no walk-forward bets yet (fewer than 20 decided games before each season). A missing season or since record is 0-0-0.
schemaNotes.cards: cards[id]: Tier 1, Tier 2 and watch-list cards with a registered side. record = the registered side over every game since 2002 (in-sample). selection = walk-forward 2018 through the last full season, the period used to select the card. sinceRegistered = the only prospective record.
schemaNotes.hiddenLines: No current-week line, odds, weather or referee is read: unplayed games are redacted before features are built. Line-dependent rows sit in gated lists and band tables for the client to unlock after the matching ballot.
